slack.method: Searched on 1 November 2026 in the UK Government Digital and GDS Slack workspaces, signed in as one person, read only: 'github <account>' for each of the catalogue's 230 GitHub accounts, newest first, up to 3,000 messages a search; a message counts when its text, link preview or blocks link to github.com/<account>/<repository>.

drive.source: Google Drive (GDS Google Workspace), via the Drive connector, signed in as the user, read only

method.query: fullText contains '"github.com/<account>"' (exact-phrase form; the unquoted form was found to return loosely related documents with no link, e.g. 5 false hits for one account)
method.snippetVerbosity: BRIEF (about 1000 characters of document lead text; chosen over MEDIUM to fit the 230-account run in context)
method.pagination: nextPageToken followed until empty; no account reached 5 pages (max 2)
method.repo_counts: lower bound: repos are extracted only from the snippet, which is the start of the document rather than the text around the match, so most links are not visible
method.phrase_matching: Drive tokenises the phrase, so a hit for account A may in rare cases come from a longer name sharing A's tokens; not observed in spot checks
method.gov_owned: owner field ends with gov.uk; files with no owner field (shared drives) count as not gov-owned
